### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the startup warnings added for unrecognized tool exclusions and feature flags. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Adds startup warnings for unrecognized `--exclude-tools` and `--features` names in the GitHub MCP server, addressing #3761 without changing tool availability or rejecting configuration. **Changes:** - Tracks excluded names that match no registered tool, including deprecated aliases. - Detects unknown feature flags and logs warnings in both stdio and HTTP startup paths; HTTP request input remains silent. - Adds tests for recognition, deduplication, exclusion whitespace handling, and alias behavior. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `pkg/​inventory/​registry.go` | Exposes unrecognized excluded tool names. | | `pkg/​inventory/​registry_test.go` | Tests exclusion diagnostics and unchanged filtering behavior. | | `pkg/​inventory/​builder.go` | Records and checks excluded names against registered tools. | | `pkg/​http/​server.go` | Logs startup warnings for unknown features and exclusions. | | `pkg/​github/​feature_flags.go` | Adds a helper to identify unknown feature flags. | | `pkg/​github/​feature_flags_test.go` | Tests feature recognition and duplicate handling. | | `internal/​ghmcp/​server.go` | Adds feature and exclusion warnings during stdio startup. |
Review effort: Balanced (auto)
